headline: On October 20, 2022: Liz Truss steps down as UK PM
captionCards: Liz Truss served as PM for only 49 days
Her brief term marked a period of political crisis
instagramCaption:
Liz Truss ends her brief term as British Prime Minister. \\[Truss, serving for just 49 days, stepped down amid a government crisis, making her the shortest-serving prime minister in British history. She held various Cabinet positions under three previous prime ministers and was the MP for South West Norfolk from 2010 to 2024.
